crossRefs.note: Behold, he will come up as clouds, and his chariots will be as the whirlwind. His horses are swifter than eagles. Woe…
For Yahweh says: “Behold, he will fly as an eagle, and will spread out his wings against Moab.
Kerioth is taken, and the strongholds are seized. The heart of the mighty men of Moab at that day will be as the heart…
Yahweh will bring a nation against you from far, from the end of the earth, as the eagle flies: a nation whose language…
“The first was like a lion, and had eagle’s wings. I watched until its wings were plucked, and it was lifted up from…
“Put the trumpet to your lips! Something like an eagle is over Yahweh’s house, because they have broken my covenant…
For I have sworn by myself,” says Yahweh, “that Bozrah will become an astonishment, a reproach, a waste, and a curse.…
Damascus has grown feeble, she turns herself to flee, and trembling has seized her. Anguish and sorrows have taken hold…
For I have heard a voice as of a woman in travail, the anguish as of her who gives birth to her first child, the voice…
We have heard its report. Our hands become feeble. Anguish has taken hold of us, and pains as of a woman in labor.
What will you say, when he sets over you as head those whom you have yourself taught to be friends to you? Won’t…
Inhabitant of Lebanon, who makes your nest in the cedars, how greatly to be pitied you will be when pangs come on you…
Ask now, and see whether a man travails with child. Why do I see every man with his hands on his waist, as a woman in…
Kerioth is taken, and the strongholds are seized. The heart of the mighty men of Moab at that day will be as the heart…
The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death came on me.
They will be dismayed. Pangs and sorrows will seize them. They will be in pain like a woman in labor. They will look in…
Therefore my thighs are filled with anguish. Pains have seized me, like the pains of a woman in labor. I am in so much…
Just as a woman with child, who draws near the time of her delivery, is in pain and cries out in her pangs, so we have…
For when they are saying, “Peace and safety,” then sudden destruction will come on them, like birth pains on a pregnant…

people.name: Edom
people.line: Descendants of Esau; enemy nation southeast of Israel

translations.web: Behold, he will come up and fly as the eagle, and spread out his wings against Bozrah. The heart of the mighty men of Edom at that day will be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.
translations.bsb: Look! An eagle will soar and swoop down, spreading its wings over Bozrah. In that day the hearts of Edom’s mighty men will be like the heart of a woman in labor.
translations.kjv: Behold, he shall come up and fly as the eagle, and spread his wings over Bozrah: and at that day shall the heart of the mighty men of Edom be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.
translations.asv: Behold, he shall come up and fly as the eagle, and spread out his wings against Bozrah: and the heart of the mighty men of Edom at that day shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.
